name: Notch
description: A plugin for cornercase that shows the coding agents that need you in the macOS notch, and answers their permission prompts and questions there.
lines: A plugin for cornercase that shows the coding agents that need you in the macOS notch, and answers their permission prompts and questions there.
It asks for status, read, keys, focus; that is shown, not enforced.

It downloads https://github.com/jacogaz/cornercase-notch/releases/download/v0.1.1/cornercase-notch-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz and checks its sha256 e813f874b3229357c3653cb2b9d27705a391e5f21838cb07e4030844e890043b.
Once on, it runs as you and can do anything you can, in every terminal: read its code or trust its author.
